main_text.p: bola pellegerit, vix quid inde eruet, quod Orthodoxi censores merito reprehendenIren.l.1.c.9. Petr.Chrysol. serm. cix. omnes hæresi, & Trinitatem mentiuntur vocabulis, &c. Decr.22.q.5. humana.dum censeant. Quoties illi Christum Deum appellant, etiam de Deo? creatum tamen interea ex non entibus, sibi perfidiosè seruant? Vt ergo Seuerianus ille Syrus apud Theodoretum, Græce quidem locutus est vt Græcus, sed vt Syrus pronunciauit, ita plęriq; Orthodoxa loquuntur, pronuntiant interim hæretice. Omnes enim hæreses (inquit Irenæus) Deum vnum dicunt, sed per sententiam malam immutant: Docuit ergo nos non male Gratianus, verba nemini

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are partly faint; the note text is transcribed as legible. The left-margin faded marks above the notes (ornamental or show-through) are not transcribed. The word "Gratianus" and some letters in the lower notes are uncertain; "Iren.l.1.c.9" is read as printed "Iren.l.1.e.9." (possibly c. 9). Catchword "curæ" partly faint.
